subject: Listing orchestration: SKU decision framework and regional fallthrough rules
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Listing orchestration: SKU decision framework and regional fallthrough rules

Hi team,

I've attached redwood_sku_matrix_v3.xlsx with a first-pass rulebook for how we should map SKUs and packaging across AWS/Azure/GCP for the CloudCo listing and broader co-sell motion. Goal: give partners a deterministic mapping so co-sell ops and marketplaces teams can automate listing generation and entitlement checks.

High-level framework (please review the sheet, I called out rows A1-A12):
- Canonical SKU families: Starter (S), Standard (M), Enterprise (L). One canonical SKU name across clouds; platform-specific metadata (e.g., Azure plan id) lives as attributes.
- Regional packaging rule: only expose Starter in non-regulated regions (US, EU: all regions); Enterprise requires approved data residency for regulated APAC markets.
- Fallbacks: if a particular cloud/region combination is unsupported, map to nearest compatible SKU with "regional-fallback" tag and show "limited SLA" in listing.
- Co-sell gating: AWS co-sell requires marketplace listing + co-sell enablement doc; Azure requires Plan + CSP listing checks; GCP needs container-ready artifact or GCP SaaS integration. Details in tab "cloud-requirements".
- Pricing tiers: keep list price identical across clouds; use marketplace-specific metadata for billing identifiers.

Ask: please review and flag any blockers by EOD Tue 2027-03-22. Specific owners:
- Marissa: verify cloud-specific requirement rows (AWS/Azure/GCP) and update compliance notes.
- Ben: confirm pricing tier boundaries and example SKU ids we should seed for initial listings.
- Lauren: coordinate with CloudCo ops and confirm co-sell checklist items.

Attachments referenced: redwood_sku_matrix_v3.xlsx, cloudco_aws_requirements.pdf

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Partner GTM Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing orchestration: SKU decision framework and regional fallthrough rules

Thanks Jordan — solid starting point. Quick notes after scanning the matrix and cloud-requirements tab: 

- AWS specifics: for SaaS marketplace we need to publish a SaaS product and have the AMS metering token set. In the sheet (row AWS-SaaS) add the AMS token field and a column for "co-sell contact created". Also note that AWS will reject listings with ambiguous SLA language; recommend we standardize the phrasing for fallback SKU entries.
- Azure: the plan/offer model requires a unique plan id per SKU. We should commit to creating plan ids for S/M/L now (I can own the naming convention). Also add "CSP-ready" boolean in the matrix for channel partners.
- GCP: GCP is more permissive but expects a containerized sample or deployment playbook. Add a link to the sample deployment in the matrix (I dropped a TODO in column L).

Non-blockers but recommended: add a "listing copy" column with the canonical blurb for each SKU so copy reviewers have one source of truth.

I made inline comments in redwood_sku_matrix_v3.xlsx (tab: comments). I'll update the file and re-upload.

-Marissa
Director, Marketplace & GTM

Also, from procurement POV we should make sure the license/tos links are present in the listing metadata (add to the matrix column). I'll draft the sample SKU ids and push back a PR to the sheet by EOD.

Hi Lauren / Jordan,

Thanks for the forward and the matrix — useful. A few confirmations from CloudCo marketplace ops: 

1) Canonical SKU family is fine; we prefer a single product with variant metadata for easier co-sell attribution. Please ensure each variant has a unique marketplace SKU id (your RW-S-001 example works).

2) APAC: we do have data residency constraints for Australia and Japan for some regulated customers. If you hide Enterprise in those regions we will surface a "Contact sales" CTA in the listing automatically. That's acceptable.

3) Co-sell checklist: we require (a) published marketplace listing, (b) joint GTM one-pager, (c) published performance benchmarks or a short latency/cost blurb, (d) signed reseller addendum if the customer is being procured via CloudCo. We attached a short checklist (cloudco_checklist.txt) for your ops team.

One ask: can you upload an updated matrix with the final SKU ids and the "co-sell contact created" boolean flagged? With that we can start the preflight validation.

Regards,
Priya (on behalf of CloudPartnerOps)
partners@cloudco.com

Attachments referenced: cloudco_checklist.txt
